description: ElevenLabs' fast, low-cost voices in many languages, at half the price of v3. Up to 1,000 characters per call. Returns an MP3. Compared with other audio tools: mid-priced. Price: $0.068 per 1,000 characters (one call: $0.069 per clip (up to 1,000 characters)), charged only on success. With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per 1,000 characters), never more than this price. One call = speech for up to 1,000 characters.

language.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. en, es, fr. Default en
